  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    .fx { padding: .9rem 2rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 800; color: #073b4c; cursor: pointer;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #a5f3fc, #06b6d4 52%, #0891b2); position: relative; overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 #fff, 0 6px 14px rgba(6,182,212,.5); }
    .fx::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 8%; right: 8%; height: 42%; border-radius: 999px;
